asserts.clickEval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('div[data-ledger-resolve-bar][data-request-id="{{requestId}}"] button[data-ledger-resolve-deny]'); if (!b || b.disabled) return 'false'; b.click(); return 'clicked' })()

asserts.eval: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[data-ledger-row][data-ledger-kind="control-decision"]')]; return rows.some((r) => { const b = r.querySelector('span[data-ledger-state][data-decision="deny"]'); return b !== null && (b.textContent.trim() === 'Denied' || b.textContent.trim() === '拒绝') }) })()
